task.title: Build parallel worktree dispatcher
task.summary: Build a dispatcher that selects independent roadmap tasks and prepares isolated worktree assignments within budget and artifact-scope constraints.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki can safely maximize parallel roadmap execution by selecting independent tasks, preparing role worktrees, and assigning bounded workers without conflicting scopes.
acceptance: Dispatcher selects tasks by priority/order while excluding overlapping code/spec/roadmap/build/validation scopes.
Dispatcher creates role worktree plans and artifact claims for independent workers under configured budgets.
Dispatcher records deterministic dispatch evidence, pause reasons, and blocked dependency/wait states.
Workers get source-backed resume packets and do not share chat context.
Tests cover independent dispatch, overlap blocking, budget limits, stale holder avoidance, and resume packet generation.
non_goals: Do not merge worker diffs in this task.
Do not bypass validation gates or user approval requirements.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Dispatcher selects tasks by priority/order while excluding overlapping code/spec/roadmap/build/validation scopes.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/roadmap/selection.ts orders executable candidates by priority then roadmap order; src/session/worktree-dispatcher.ts feeds candidates into computeParallelSchedulerPlan which excludes partition conflicts and active artifact holders. tests/smoke/worktree-dispatcher.test.mjs covers priority/order selection and overlap blocking.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Dispatcher creates role worktree plans and artifact claims for independent workers under configured budgets.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: planParallelWorktreeDispatch returns assignments with builder/validator role worktree plans plus artifact_claim mark inputs/scopes/ttl/worktree metadata; tests assert branch/base_sha/claim scopes and budget maxSubagents/maxSessions behavior.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Dispatcher records deterministic dispatch evidence, pause reasons, and blocked dependency/wait states.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: WorktreeDispatchPlan includes dispatch_id hash, selected/blocked/candidate ids, skipped tasks, pause_reasons, wait_queue, publisher_queue, and blocked wait intents; tests assert deterministic dispatch_id and pause reasons.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Workers get source-backed resume packets and do not share chat context.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Each assignment/block includes resume_packet with task context path, source_refs, follow_up_intent, command, prompt, and chat_context_shared=false; tests assert source refs and no parent chat context.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Tests cover independent dispatch, overlap blocking, budget limits, stale holder avoidance, and resume packet generation.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: tests/smoke/worktree-dispatcher.test.mjs covers independent selection, partition conflict, max worker budget, active artifact claim block, expired holder non-blocking behavior, skipped blocked roadmap tasks, and resume packet fields.

closure_brief.user_intent: Keep working and implement TASK-055 after deferring live parallel wake testing.
implemented_changes: Added deterministic roadmap dispatch candidate selection.
Added parallel worktree dispatch planner with role worktree plans, artifact claim intents, blocked/wait evidence, and source-backed resume packets.
Added targeted dispatcher smoke coverage and smoke script entry.
Updated system docs for dispatcher behavior.
remaining_risks: Dispatcher currently returns claim intents/plans rather than launching workers; future task can wire execution/orchestration if policy permits.
Publisher queue remains separate and serializes merge/close in later tasks.
